name: JellyWatchParty
description: Watch movies together in sync with friends on Jellyfin
overview: Synchronized watch parties for Jellyfin. Create or join rooms to watch content together with friends, perfectly in sync.

versions.changelog:
Chat panels now start with an 80% background opacity and include a slider in Chat settings. Changes preview immediately and persist on the device, while text and controls stay readable.

The emote picker now includes hi, NOOOO, catJAM, CAUGHT, peepoRun and TrollDespair from the requested 7TV creators. peepoRun appears once; retired tokens still render in existing chat history.

Validation: 175 client/helper tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Browser checks confirmed live opacity changes, persistence after reload, and theme support. This UI update works with the existing 1.11.0 session server.

Fix shared cursors and drawing trails being invisible to watch-party guests. The guest player visibility rules now include the body-mounted cursor, nickname and SVG trail overlays while playback is open. They remain hidden when the room closes, and library navigation stays restricted.

Validation: reproduced the missing drawings in a local browser fixture before the fix and verified visible host/guest trails afterward; closed-room and library-isolation checks passed. All 16 focused client tests and 128 plugin tests passed. Live cursor delivery and release events passed between three clients in an empty disposable room, with no media playback or watch-history changes.

No session-server changes are required. Refresh host and guest tabs after updating the plugin.
Fix the clipped chain icon on the Copy link button by keeping the SVG artwork inside its 24-unit frame. Verified in a local browser preview; all 128 plugin tests passed. No session-server changes.

Adds replies to watch-party chat. Choose Reply beside a message to quote it, cancel with the preview button or Escape, and send your response to everyone in the room.

Replies use server-assigned message IDs and server-resolved quotes, survive reconnects, and retain quoted text when older messages leave the bounded chat history. Direct and WebSocket copies merge without duplicate messages; failed sends keep the draft and reply selection.

Update both the Jellyfin plugin and the session server for replies. ShareLinks 1.0.8.0 remains compatible.

Validation: 172 JavaScript tests, 118 Rust tests, 128 plugin tests and Rust Clippy passed. Live guest/browser verification is recorded in the repository deployment notes.

Create a room, copy its link, and chat before choosing a title. Guest clients stay inside the player and chat through title changes, reloads, reconnects and room closure. Chat connects while Jellyfin prepares its native player; the client ships as one ordered bundle loaded early in the page.

Reconnects refresh authentication and restore room state. Separate tabs have separate identities, and resuming an old transport requires authentication as the same user. Paused title changes, the native player opening at a later timestamp, and room lock ordering are corrected.

Random Pick excludes movies and series already displayed in Continue Watching and Next Up. Reusable injector, deployment and disposable integration scripts are included under extras/jellyfin.

Validation: 155 client JavaScript tests, 8 Random Pick tests, 128 plugin tests, 116 server tests, Rust clippy, and live API/WebSocket/browser checks. Companion ShareLinks: 1.0.8.0.

Rakkate edition: account-free direct-to-player invites, whole-series rooms, docked themed chat, custom emotes, shared cursor trails, tighter playback sync, WebRTC fast path with WebSocket fallback, guest confinement, and owner-managed room lifecycle.

This release brings a fix for #51
